solution:
The faces opposite to each other is shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7dd816d6bdd4b786119f25f474efdd223955aed24d64ddc8e297f3bb47be8e66.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8fdfb6d21946c20582285d08ddb258a062c9e7ef97612932972c5219303963c1.png] → Can be formed.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c0acdcda096780e081b719230ddf161a12d241433eb5ead805d6ae0f67afc23d.png] → Can be formed.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/26ee07ae3c3ca46471b4668f4a1eb0dae911430c7e64bba58f9791111ef53c10.png] → Cannot be formed as % and # are faces opposite to each other.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/354854ea42cce189066f615a23b2ace106f0a4155cade603539bb003d380666e.png] → Cannot be formed as % and # are faces opposite to each other.

Hence, '**only A and B**' is the correct answer.
